title: Spacemaster 80 Cucumber - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Hardy Cucumber
description:
Compact Bush Cucumber for Small Gardens & Containers - High Yield & Disease Resistant!


KEY FEATURES
• Compact bush habit, ideal for small gardens, containers, and patios.
• Produces abundant, full-sized (7-8 inch) slicing cucumbers.
• Excellent traditional cucumber flavour: crisp, refreshing, and non-bitter.
• Disease resistant to Cucumber Mosaic Virus, Downy Mildew, Powdery Mildew, and Scab.
• Quick maturity, ready for harvest in 55-65 days.


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Vegetables — Cucumis sativus
Colour: Medium green (fruit)
Season: Summer (fruiting)
Growth Habit: Bush
Flavour: Traditional crisp, refreshing cucumber taste with no bitterness.
Time to Harvest: 55-65 days


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun (6+ hours daily)
Soil: Warm, fertile, well-drained loam with good organic content
Watering: Consistent and abundant moisture; avoid drought stress. Water at soil level.
Spacing: 12-18 inches (18 inches for containers)
Height: 0 ft 8 in - 1 ft 6 in
Spread: 3 ft 0 in - 8 ft 0 in
Hardiness: Tender (cannot tolerate frost)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant in warm soil (minimum 18°C) after all danger of frost has passed.
• Provide consistent moisture, especially for container-grown plants, but avoid overwatering.
• Feed regularly with a balanced fertiliser, particularly for plants in pots.
• Harvest frequently (every 2-3 days) when fruits are 6-8 inches long and firm to encourage continuous production.
• Consider providing afternoon shade in extremely hot climates (above 29°C) to prevent bolting.
• If container growing, use pots at least 12-15 inches deep and 18 inches wide with good drainage.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants


DISPATCH
Plants are carefully packed and dispatched Monday-Wednesday to avoid weekend delays.
